audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Tongue Lash a stun without its condition, and calls Devour '(W)' and '(R/W depending)'.
audit.why: Tongue Lash stuns ONLY if the target already carries three stacks of An Acquired Taste, which he accumulates by damaging you; otherwise it damages, slows and heals him. Devour is R; W is Abyssal Dive, the dive-and-reappear knockup.
audit.corrected: Break contact at two stacks and the tongue cannot stun you; Devour (R) is his save tool, Abyssal Dive (W, 21s at rank 1) is the engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive's knockup is never connected to Last Breath, and Thick Skin's mechanic is described only as 'shield'.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags the displacement pairing. Abyssal Dive knocks YOU up — Last Breath blinks to an airborne ENEMY, so his knockup gives you nothing and you must make your own with the two-stack tornado. Thick Skin banks a percentage of the damage he takes and converts it to a shield on a 3s cooldown, which is why chip poke into him is self-defeating.
audit.corrected: Make your own knockup; do not wait on his. Expect the damage you deal to come back as his shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere in the content layer.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags Tongue Lash and Thick Skin as heal sources — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. The full layer mentions it once in the itemization line only.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal written into the level-6 spike and wants.you.

audit.why: Tongue Lash 7s at rank 1 down to 5s, Abyssal Dive 21s at rank 1, Thick Skin 3s, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1. The mirror flags that this page's counterpart wrote Wind Wall's cooldown as five seconds — the one number the lane turns on.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, early and the spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows read Tahm Kench while their whys explain a Yasuo win.
audit.why: win[5] read 'Tahm Kench' beside 'your crit spike beats his tanky, low-damage kit'. The packet levelChart reads Skill, Yasuo, Skill, Skill, Yasuo, Yasuo, Yasuo, which matches the whys and the 51.58% win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned to the packet chart as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

edits.before: Skill-based trading window: Tahm's Tongue Lash (Q) stun and passive Thick Skin shield make him a sturdy poke-tank, so a landed Q into three-stack chomp hurts. Wind Wall his Tongue Lash to kill his poke and slow, and E-Q in only when his Q is down — eat the tongue and he sets up a devour trade.
edits.after: Skill-based window: Tongue Lash (Q, 7s at rank 1) only stuns once you already carry three An Acquired Taste stacks, which he builds by damaging you — so break contact at two. Wind Wall the tongue to deny the poke and slow, and E-Q in while it is down; Thick Skin banks your damage into his shield.

edits.before: You start to edge ahead here — Tahm has no burst and Devour (R/W depending) is a utility tool, not a duel win. Bait his Q, Windwall it, then all-in; his answer is to shield with Thick Skin and stall, but he can't out-damage your R combo when his tongue is on cooldown.
edits.after: You edge ahead here — Tahm has no burst, and Devour (R) is a save tool, not a duel win. Bait the tongue, wall it, then all-in: his answer is Thick Skin (E, 3s) turning stored damage into a shield, so carry Grievous Wounds and keep swinging through the stall.

edits.before: You spike: crit item plus E-Q burst beats his tanky-but-low-damage kit, and Windwall shuts off his one ranged threat. Respect that he can W-devour a diving ally or himself to escape, but in a straight lane 1v1 you out-DPS his Thick Skin sustain.
edits.after: You spike: crit item plus E-Q burst beats his tanky, low-damage kit, and Wind Wall shuts off his one ranged threat. Respect Abyssal Dive (W, 21s at rank 1) — it knocks YOU up, and Last Breath fires only on an airborne enemy, so make your own tornado.

edits.before: Late favours you in a duel — Tahm is a peel/save tank whose value is Devouring allies, not killing you. Windwall his Tongue Lash, save E to dodge his slow, and don't let him tongue you into his team; 1v1 your crit DPS chews through his shield.
edits.after: Late favours you in a duel — Tahm is a peel/save tank whose value is Devouring allies, not killing you. Wind Wall the Tongue Lash, sidestep the Abyssal Dive circle, and never let him tongue you into his team; 1v1 your DPS beats Thick Skin.

edits.before: Early is skill-based around his Tongue Lash: land it and his stun-into-chomp plus Thick Skin shield win a trade, so Windwall the Q and only E-Q in when it's down.
edits.after: Early is skill-based around Tongue Lash (7s at rank 1): it stuns only at three passive stacks, so break contact at two and E-Q in while the tongue is down.

edits.before: By levels 5-6 you edge ahead — Tahm has no burst, so bait and Windwall his Q, then all-in while he can only shield and stall.
edits.after: By levels 5-6 you edge ahead — Tahm has no burst, so bait the tongue, then all-in with anti-heal up while he shields and stalls.

notes: One thing I kept but could not confirm from the kits: that Wind Wall blocks Tongue Lash. The kit file gives his Q hardCC, slow and heal flags but no projectile flag, and the brief's rules say an absent flag means UNKNOWN rather than no. The mirror audit also treats the wall as relevant here, so I left the existing claims in place rather than removing advice on an unresolved point — but if the applier's owner can confirm it either way, several lines on both pages depend on it. dosFull[2].t and dontsFull[0].t are under 25 characters and will be skipped by the applier.
